title: Tweaks N' Trinkets
description: A small mod adding mostly unrelated equipment and decoration items.
body:
This mod uses a modified version of Fabric (Babric) and is designed only for Better than Adventure, a heavily modified version of Minecraft b1.7.3! For more information, join the discord server provided on this projects page.

Currently Adds these Items:  
- Nether Torch: Cosmetic Torch Variation crafted with a regular torch and Nether Coal.

- Magic Mirror: Teleports you to your spawn point when used. Has a 30 minute cooldown and can be found in Labyrinths. Can only be used in the Overworld.

- Obsidian Glass: Made by smelting Igneous Cobbled Netherrack in the Blast Furnace. Has a high explosion resistance, similiar to obsidian, but is easier to mine than regular glass.

- Obsidian Glass Shard: Has a 1/3 chance of dropping from Obsidian Glass.

- Obsidian Glass Dagger: Crafted with 7 Obsidian Glass shards and a stick. Very high damage, but only has 5 durability  

Source code can be found here:
https://github.com/AtIgnister/bta-tweaks-n-trinkets
